listed_sector_signals.signal: Reference citation to a paper on energy efficiency improvement in the cement industry (cement is a listed continuous-production sector); appears only in the bibliography, not in the paper's own application
listed_sector_signals.quote:
Improvement in the Cement Industry through Energy Management. 
In: 2012 IEEE-IAS/PCA 54th Cement Industry Technical Conference.

one_line: The paper applies an ISO 50001 energy-review methodology to a university campus (higher education buildings) in Cali, Colombia; the only cement reference is a bibliographic citation, not an application context.
